title: 7-Day Tanzania Camping Safari
overview:
This Tanzania camping trip lasts for 7 days and lets you see the
                        best parts of the Northern Safari Circuit. You will see monkeys in the forest,
                        lions in the trees, elephants among acacias, and a huge variety of animals 
                        inside a collapsed volcano. You will also go to Serengeti National Park, 
                        which is known all over the world. The landscapes are breathtaking, and 
                        the amount and variety of wildlife you will see will stay with you forever. The best.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you will be met by our representative and transferred to your hotel in Arusha for safari briefing and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Tarangire National Park for game drives. The park is famous for its large elephant herds and ancient baobab trees.

itinerary.title: Tarangire to Serengeti National Park
itinerary.description: Depart Tarangire and drive through the scenic Ngorongoro highlands to Serengeti National Park for afternoon game viewing.

itinerary.title: Full Day Serengeti Game Drives
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full day of game drives in Serengeti, home to the Big Five and the famous wildebeest migration.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Conservation Area
itinerary.description: Morning game drive in Serengeti followed by transfer to Ngorongoro Conservation Area with stunning crater views.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Tour
itinerary.description: Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for a half-day game drive. Spot rhinos, lions, hippos and many bird species.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro to Arusha – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive back to Arusha where your safari ends with transfer to the airport or hotel.

title: ZANZIBAR ISLAND
route: The Zanzibar archipelago is one of the most historic Indian Ocean islands, awash with atmosphere, intrigue, and idyllic beach experiences.
overview:
The journey begins in **Stone Town**, 
                         a UNESCO World Heritage site. Walking through its narrow,
                         winding alleys is like stepping back in time. 
                         You are greeted by the scent of cloves and cinnamon, 
                         and the sight of magnificent, intricately carved wooden doors that tell stories of Arabic,
                         Indian, and African heritage.

title: PEMBA
route: Pemba Island is part of Tanzania's Zanzibar Archipelago, off the coast of East Africa. It's known for its lush, green hills and clove plantations.
